Modifications: retain password email login, protocol models/errors, encrypted
transport and pure Python signer only. Remove native signer, phone fallback,
JWT login, cloud writes, device enumeration and BLE credential-pair helpers.
Bundled profile source was NOT copied; profiles.py is a no-identities shim.
Transport disables redirects, requires HTTP 200, and ignores environment overrides.
Integration adds an independent action/version whitelist and login budget,
strict explicit region pinning, private-profile validation, exact device/localKey
validation and sanitized public errors. Runtime dependencies: aiohttp, cryptography.
